observed_defect_remediation.defect: scripts/g1g3_offline_ports_r1/market_pit_port.py _translate_funding checked wall_ms >= settlement_at and avail_ms == settlement_at, rejecting legitimate settlement REST records arriving after the economic charge.
observed_defect_remediation.repair: Replaced avail_ms == settlement_at with avail_ms >= settlement_at and wall_ms >= settlement_at. Preserved immutable economic settlement_at on output g1_event['at'] while advancing feature_known_at_ms to receiver available_at_ms strictly without backdating. Implemented duplicate replay idempotence, same-settlement-id conflicting rate/mark hard fail, and receipt-before-settlement fail closed.

1_on_time_settled_funding.evidence: available_at_ms == settlement_at_ms accepted; g1_event emitted at economic settlement timestamp.

2_3s_and_multi_minute_late_receipt.evidence: 3s late (t+3s) and 5m late (t+300s) REST receipts accepted; available_at_ms reflects receiver known-at; economic event clock remains pinned to settlement_at_ms.

3_unchanged_earlier_decision_feature_vie.evidence: Earlier decision at t=60_000 valid prior to receipt; after late funding arrival at t=120_000, decision at t=60_000 fails DECISION_BEFORE_FEATURE_KNOWN_AT, proving no retroactive leakage.

4_duplicate_replay_idempotence.evidence: Exact and re-keyed duplicate settlement replays return DUPLICATE_IGNORED with g1_event=None, preserving exactly-once ledger semantics without downstream double-charge.

5_same_settlement_id_conflicting_rate_ma.evidence: Same settlement ID with conflicting rate or conflicting Mark price hard fails with SafetyViolation('FUNDING_SETTLEMENT_CONFLICT').

6_receipt_before_settlement_reject.evidence: wall_ms < settlement_at or avail_ms < settlement_at fails closed with SafetyViolation('FUNDING_PIT_INVALID'); future reference fails MARKET_EVENT_FUTURE_KNOWN.

7_missing_mark_rate_cost_incomplete.evidence: Missing mark_price or rate_fraction yields status COST_INCOMPLETE with cash_flow=None; never silently assumed zero.

8_funding_credit_debit_side_symmetry.evidence: LONG pays positive rate (cash < 0); SHORT receives positive rate (cash > 0); cash flows sum to exactly Decimal(0) conservation.

9_exposure_before_vs_after_partial_fill_.evidence: Partial exit before settlement reduces economic exposure at settlement; partial exit after settlement does not alter economic exposure at settlement regardless of delayed receipt time.

10_ambiguous_fill_vs_settlement_boundary.evidence: Fill executed at exact settlement millisecond raises SafetyViolation('AMBIGUOUS_SETTLEMENT_BOUNDARY').

11_reconnect_or_clock_regression_fail_cl.evidence: Monotonic regression raises MONOTONIC_REGRESSION; wall regression raises CLOCK_UNCERTAIN; epoch regression raises CONNECTION_EPOCH_REGRESSION; CLOCK_UNCERTAIN reason code fails closed.

12_zero_real_funding_complete_witnessed_.evidence: Rate 0.0 with incomplete coverage or missing mark yields COST_INCOMPLETE; exact 0.0 cash flow realized only under complete verified coverage.
